faq.question: How long does it take to launch a website?
faq.answer: For our standard Web Presence plans, websites are typically launched in 2 to 3 weeks. Custom builds or web applications can take anywhere from 4 to 8 weeks depending on the complexity of functionality and integrations.

faq.question: Do you provide maintenance and updates?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide ongoing maintenance, security updates, and performance optimizations. We want to ensure your site remains lightning-fast and highly secure long after launch.

faq.question: How do we track the performance of ad campaigns?
faq.answer: We configure advanced tracking funnels (using Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, etc.) and deliver clear, transparent weekly/monthly performance reports. You'll see exactly how much you spend and the direct revenue generated.
